title: LeadSubmitRequest
description: Submit one consented automotive inquiry through MCP, A2A or PAP. Customer, consent, source_agent and idempotency_key are required. Vehicle interest and trade-in may contain partial user-provided information. An optional appointment requires appointment_type; requesting a visit does not itself confirm a booking.

consent.description: Consent record covering this submission. Required. `scope` MUST be ["lead_submission"].

vehicle_of_interest.description: The vehicle the buyer is interested in purchasing. Optional. May be any vehicle type — set `vehicle_type` to `motorcycle` and pass motorcycle fields (`body`, `displacement_cc`, etc.) for a bike lead. Pass through whatever the customer provided (VIN alone, year+make+model, just a model name, etc.) — no individual field is required. When `condition` is set it MUST be one of `new` | `used` | `cpo`.

trade_in.description: Optional partial description of the buyer’s trade-in. Pass through known information without inventing fields. When condition is present, use excellent, good, fair or poor. This skill does not return an appraisal or valuation.

appointment.description: An appointment request the buyer wants scheduled alongside this lead. Optional. `appointment_type` is one of `sales` | `service` | `test_drive` | `trade_in`, and `appointment_at` is the requested start time. The vehicle for the appointment is implicit: `vehicle_of_interest` for a test drive, `trade_in` for a trade-in appraisal.

message.description: Optional free-text message from the buyer to the dealer.

source_agent.description: Buyer-agent attribution. This caller-supplied label is not authentication and must not override verified transport identity.

name.description: Stable identifier of the buyer agent.

url.description: Optional homepage / operator URL for the buyer agent.

agent_card_url.description: Optional URL of the buyer agent's A2A Agent Card for attribution and discovery. Fetching a public card does not authenticate the sender; verified transport identity remains separate.

submitted_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp at which the buyer agent finalized this submission (e.g. '2026-04-30T11:05:08Z').

idempotency_key.description: Required client-generated key (UUID recommended) for this consented submission. Preserve the key and payload after a timeout or session renewal. Deduplicate for at least 24 hours by dealer and verified caller, including the stable PAP User ID where applicable; anonymous calls use dealer and key. The same caller and key across bindings return the complete original result with data.replayed true, including its received/rejected status and appointment details; a changed payload returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Reauthorize the caller before replay; the original consent must have been valid for the initial delivery. A replay creates no new delivery or booking.

allOf.description: vehicle_of_interest.condition (when set) must be in the sale-condition vocabulary
trade_in.condition (when set) must be in the wear-condition vocabulary
